en: When a battle starts, creates a magic sigil beneath the [[rearmost]] ally. While standing on the sigil, the ally becomes [[unaffected]] and gains [[30]] Haste and [[20%]] DMG Reduction. When the ally leaves the sigil, these bonuses are lost for [[3]]s before the sigil relocates beneath the ally's new position. If the sigil remains active for [[10]] consecutive seconds, the Haste bonus further increases to [[50]]. The [[unaffected]] effect can last up to [[15]]s. Once the ally has left the sigil, it no longer grants [[unaffected]].
zh: 战斗开始时，在布阵时[[最靠后]]的友军脚下生成法阵。法阵会使该友军获得[[30]]点急速、[[20%]]伤害减免以及[[霸体]]。当该友军离开法阵后，效果会中断[[3]]秒，随后重新在该友军脚下生成。法阵连续生效[[10]]秒后，其提供的急速值提高至[[50]]点。[[霸体]]至多持续[[15]]秒，且友军离开过法阵后，该法阵不再提供[[霸体]]效果。

en: Also creates a secondary sigil beneath the frontmost ally. It grants [[50%]] of the buffs provided by the original sigil and is interrupted whenever the original sigil is interrupted.
